title: I built a medieval castle defense game for iPhone and iPad with AI. Here’s a day-to-night cycle of gameplay
author: NoobStickz98
selftext:
That’s me playing the first stage, Greenvale.  
  
**Castle Defense: Medieval** is a village builder mixed with tower defense. By day, you gather wood, stone and food and build your town. At dusk, your villagers take up arms. By night, you hold off raider waves with towers, siege engines, soldiers and arrow volleys.

**How AI was used**

* Started as a prototype in a Claude chat, then moved into Claude Code for \~ 1k commits
* All the 3D models, animations, maps and UI are code-generated with three.js, with no art packs
* I designed each stage as a 2D sketch first, then had it built in 3D from the sketch
* Playtesting was just me on my phone, sending screenshots with arrows and circles drawn on them
* Wrapped as an iOS app with Capacitor

App Store: [https://apps.apple.com/app/id6832629905](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6832629905)  
Website: [https://castledefense.app](https://castledefense.app)

Free to download with the first 3 stages! Do give it a shot and let me know what you think!
